svg.aria-label: Concurrency: one cook switching between four boiling pots. Parallelism: four cooks chopping at four boards, one per CPU core.
svg.title: Concurrency: one cook switching between four boiling pots. Parallelism: four cooks chopping at four boards, one per CPU core.
svg.text: Two different ways for a kitchen to handle four orders at once
While pot 1 boils, the cook stirs pot 2. Waiting is free.
Chopping can’t be awaited. It needs more hands.
